The '''Great Mother River''' was a [[river]] that ran through the upper level jungle on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. [[Isttu Village]] was built around a wide branch of the river known as [[Isttu Lake]].
